latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the maverick-pandadoc-mcp skill.
- Provides a context for working with PandaDoc documents, templates, recipients, proposals, and status using Maverick-provisioned OAuth credentials.
- No provider-owned PandaDoc MCP manifest is registered yet; runtime tools must be inspected and used with care.
- Includes guidance on authentication, safety, data flow, and required dependencies (mcporter, jq, flock, shasum).
